meta.name: void-default
meta.cssVarConvention: Every semantic token below carries an explicit `cssVar`. The dotted name is the contract; the custom property is the emitted artefact. They are deliberately not derivable from one another — the CSS names predate this file and are load-bearing in shipped components, so the mapping is stated rather than computed.

sourceProvenance.mode: B — code / asset bundle, with two mode-A references for feel only

supplied.what: Tailwind v4 / shadcn `@theme inline` block plus `:root` and `.dark` token sets

supplied.role: reference for feel only — not reproduced
layout vocabulary for the back office only — no colour, size or radius taken

supplied.what: ADR-001 revising the NFR-PERF-19 theme payload budget

sourceProvenance.licencePosition: All shipped assets are OFL-1.1 or ISC, self-hosted. The AdminCN template is MIT and is not redistributed — no file from it ships. See docs/licences/README.md.
ownerConstraints: Signal orange accent, always on — no greyscale variant, no runtime toggle (2026-09-05).
Grey photography placeholders stay until real shots land (2026-09-05).
Do not draw, reconstruct or approximate a Void logo.
No hand-drawn icons; Lucide (ISC) is the authorised set.

adaptations.change: Source theme named `--font-geist-sans`/`--font-geist-mono` with no font strategy. Replaced with five self-hosted subset faces, `font-display: swap`, two preloaded on the critical path.
adaptations.why: A template's font strategy is replaced if it does not subset, self-host and preload.

adaptations.change: Added a third family (Anek Bangla as `Void Bengali`) and a `:lang(bn)` scope that swaps the face and raises `--leading-relaxed` to 1.8.
adaptations.why: The source theme was Latin-only. Bengali conjuncts and matras need both glyph coverage and more leading.

adaptations.change: Split every feedback tone into four roles (`-text` / `-bg` / `-border` / `-solid` + `-on-solid`) and introduced `--border-control` distinct from `--border-default`.
adaptations.why: No single value per tone is legible both as type on the canvas and as a fill; the source theme had one value per tone. `--border-default` (1.24:1) cannot serve as a control boundary needing 3:1.

adaptations.change: Amber fills carry near-black type (`--warning-on-solid`), never white.
adaptations.why: White on the amber fill measures 1.9:1. Dark type measures 9.41:1.

adaptations.change: Default control height set to 44px (`--control-h-md`); the 36px step is allowlisted to pointer-only surfaces and only with an expanded hit area.
adaptations.why: The source theme's default control height was 36px.

adaptations.change: `font.size.base` pinned to 16px and body bound to it; the 11–14px steps are scoped to dense portal chrome, never body or product copy.
adaptations.why: Body text may not fall below 16px equivalent.

adaptations.change: `motion.duration.slow` is 320ms and the longest duration in the system is 600ms (editorial imagery only).
No remote origin anywhere in the token closure. Icons are one local Lucide subset sprite; fonts are local.

adaptations.why: DISCLOSED DEFAULT. Only 400 and 500 exist as subset files. Pointing these at 600/700 would make the browser synthesise a faux weight. The contract requires the tokens to exist; the system refuses to ship weights it does not have.

adaptations.change: `color.commerce.trust` resolves to the success tone rather than a distinct trust hue.
adaptations.why: DISCLOSED DEFAULT. The source theme defined no trust colour and the palette is achromatic apart from the accent.

adaptations.change: Bengali face selected as Anek Bangla (OFL-1.1, Ek Type).
adaptations.why: DISCLOSED DEFAULT — a judgement call, not a given. Matches Geist's low-contrast near-geometric build and carries the eleven GSUB features conjuncts need. Awaiting Product Owner confirmation.

extensions.$comment: Values Void ships beyond Appendix I. Listed so the contract is not silently extended (UI-SRC-6).
extensions.color.border.control: ≥3:1 boundary of an interactive control, distinct from the decorative default
extensions.color.action.accent.*: the single accent fill, primary commerce CTA only
extensions.color.accent.*: signal-orange marking layer: text, fill, on-fill, bg, border
extensions.color.commerce.badge.*.bg / .text / .bor: each badge is three roles, not one value
extensions.radius.xl / .2xl / .3xl / .4xl / .media: the source theme's own multiplier chain, plus radius.media: 0
extensions.space.05: 2px half-step for chips and dense table padding
extensions.chrome.*: fixed sidebar, topbar and Studio rail dimensions
extensions.motion.duration.editorial: 600ms — product and hero imagery cross-fade only
extensions.blur.panel / .scrim: the only two transparency uses in the system

notes: Component code may reference the semantic tier only. The primitive tier exists so semantic tokens have something to point at.
Every pairing in both schemes is measured in guidelines/contrast-report.md — 100 pairings, 0 failures.

Compatibility aliases (--background, --primary, --muted, --card, --sidebar-*, --chart-*) are emitted by tokens/colors.css so the shadcn-shaped names from the source theme keep resolving. They are not part of this contract and new code must not use them.

chart.$comment: Adjacent-fill data colour only. A chart hue on a button, link, icon or brand surface is a defect.

stack.voidSans: "Void Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
stack.voidBengali: "Void Bengali", "Void Sans", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Hind Siliguri", sans-serif

face.$comment: The five shipped binaries. Weights 300, 600 and 700 are deliberately absent.

size.$comment: Raw scale. 4px base with a 2px half-step; the type ramp is fluid from xl up.

accent.$comment: EXTENSION. One fill per view — the single most important commerce action. Never a second one.
EXTENSION. The marking layer. Type uses .text; fills use .fill and carry .onFill. Never white on the fill.

onSolid.measured: 9.41:1 — amber fills never carry white type

semibold.disclosedDefault: No 600 file is subset or shipped. Resolves to 500 rather than inviting a synthesised faux weight.

bold.disclosedDefault: No 700 file is subset or shipped. Resolves to 500 rather than inviting a synthesised faux weight.

relaxed.note: The bn scope value is what satisfies UI-INV-5 for matras and conjuncts.

none.note: Single-line controls. Named because the token-literal rule (UI-SRC-9) surfaced it as an unnamed literal in Button; the value is the one that already shipped, not a new choice.

widest.use: the uppercase eyebrow / nav / table-header layer

role.$comment: Composite shorthands. Component code sets `font:` from these rather than assembling size + weight + leading by hand.

none.note: No custom property is emitted; use 0 directly or radius.media.

media.use: product and editorial imagery — never rounded

shadow.$comment: Never the sole indicator of state. A hairline is always the first choice.

thin.note: The only border width used in the system.

icon.note: Icon and spinner stroke on the 24px Lucide grid. Was an unnamed literal in Icon and Button.

measure.$comment: EXTENSION. Character-based measures for short copy. Surfaced by the token-literal rule as unnamed 42ch/56ch literals in the reference state components; values preserved, not re-picked. layout.maxWidth.prose (68ch) remains the editorial measure.

breakpoint.$comment: Values are theme-supplied; the behaviour at each tier is fixed by SRS §9.4 and does not change with the theme.

xs.behaviour: single column; bottom-sheet filters; sticky add-to-cart bar

lg.behaviour: three or four column grid; persistent filter sidebar

xl.behaviour: four-column grid at max content width, centred

min.note: V5. Controls shorter than this expand their hit area via the .void-touch-safe helper in tokens/base.css.

heightSm.note: NOT a touch size. Allowlisted to pointer-only surfaces, and only with an expanded hit area.

spinner.note: Button's loading spinner. Value preserved exactly as shipped rather than snapped to the 14/16/20 icon scale, because re-picking it is a design decision (ADR-0007).

underlineOffset.note: Link and product-title underline offset, already used by base.css.

icon.$comment: EXTENSION. readme.md fixes the icon ramp: 14px dense tables, 16px default UI, 18-20px storefront headers and Studio tool rails. Never below 14px. Named so a call site passes a step, not a number — a numeric size prop would be a literal under UI-SRC-9.

controlBox.note: Checkbox and radio visual box. The BOX is 16px; the effective target is the label row at --touch-target-min (UI-INV-3).

switch.$comment: EXTENSION. Switch track and knob. The reference carried these as bare numbers (32/18/40/22 and a knob derived as h-6); named here with the shipped values preserved.

checkGlyph.note: The tick drawn inside a checked box.

iconButton.$comment: EXTENSION. Square icon-only control. sm and md are BELOW the 44px minimum, so IconButton applies .void-touch-safe to them automatically — the visual size is the design's, the effective target is UI-INV-3's.

badge.$comment: EXTENSION. Badge is a status label, never interactive, so it is exempt from the touch minimum.

tag.note: Pill height. An interactive Tag carries .void-touch-safe, because 28px is not a target.

chrome.$comment: EXTENSION. Fixed chrome dimensions. Sidebars and top bars are the only fixed/sticky elements in the system.

zIndex.$comment: Strictly increasing, no duplicates (V10). Nothing in the system may declare an ad-hoc z-index.

editorial.use: product and hero imagery cross-fade only

spin.note: Continuous, and killed centrally by prefers-reduced-motion. Under the 800ms V9 ceiling.

shimmer.note: Exceeds the 800ms figure quoted in readme.md, and does not breach UI-INV-8: that invariant caps PAGE-TRANSITION motion at 800ms and forbids animation that delays interaction. A continuous loading loop is neither, and prefers-reduced-motion stops it centrally. Value preserved from the reference kit, not re-picked.

reduced.note: Substituted for every animation and transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion by tokens/base.css.

blur.$comment: EXTENSION. Two uses only: the dialog scrim and sticky storefront headers over imagery. Never on cards, never as decoration.

opacity.$comment: EXTENSION. Surfaced by the token-literal rule: Button carried 0.45 as an unnamed literal.

disabled.note: 45% plus cursor:not-allowed. No grey-out repaint (readme.md, Disabled).

validation.$comment: Self-reported status against Appendix I §I.3, RETAINED FOR HISTORY ONLY. packages/tokens/src/validate.mjs re-derives every rule and is authoritative; where the two disagree the validator is right. Four of these statements were found stale on 2026-09-06 and are corrected below — see docs/adr/0008-recorded-figures.md.

V1.evidence: Every required semantic token present with an explicit cssVar. Four contract tokens resolve to disclosed defaults — see meta.adaptations.

V2.evidence: Re-derived: 98 pairings across light + dark, 0 unwaived failures. CORRECTED: the previous evidence claimed 100 pairings; guidelines/contrast-report.md itself states 92. One pairing FAILS and is waived — commerce.rating vs rating.empty at 2.24:1 light / 2.84:1 dark, a regression from the accent decision that the contrast report never re-measured (ADR-0009).

V6.evidence: Re-derived from the shipped woff2 by decompressing the table directory: GSUB, GDEF and cmap present; ten of the eleven conjunct features present. CORRECTED: 'akhn' is NOT in either Bengali face, so the previous 'all eleven' claim was false. Not fatal — no akhand conjunct appears in the test strings. Shaping itself is asserted in the browser by the theme-swap gate, which is the only place it can be.

V7.evidence: Re-derived from the GENERATED theme: token CSS 5,240 B gzip -9 + Geist 400/500 26,252 B = 31,492 B against the 40,960 B ceiling (76.9%). CORRECTED: the previous figure of 34,762 B measured the hand-authored tokens/*.css, whose comments are not shipped. The hand-authored files actually gzip to 10,675 B, not the 8,510 B recorded. Bengali pair 102,960 B against the 110KB advisory target.

V8.evidence: No remote URL in the token closure. Fonts and the icon sprite are local.

V9.evidence: motion.duration.slow = 320ms; motion.reduced = 0.01ms exists and is applied.

V11.evidence: meta.licenceRef resolves and every shipped face has a licence file beside it. CORRECTED: OFL-1.1-Geist.txt was absent from docs/licences/ when this was last checked — it was present in git at commit 9602085 and had been deleted from the working tree, not missing from the project. Restored.

V12.evidence: meta.isPlaceholder is false. No placeholder set ships — the design source arrived before styling began.

composite.$comment: Values assembled FROM semantic tokens: composite shorthands, the focus-ring recipe, and the v1.0 shadcn-shaped aliases the source theme shipped. Emitted after the semantic tier so they inherit a scheme swap without redefinition. Extracted verbatim from the hand-authored tokens/*.css in styles.css @import order — no value re-picked.
